brief:
An-Najah National University and the Nablus Businessmen Forum are preparing to launch Tedi Najah Expo 2026, according to Maan Wire. The event will run from September 22-26, 2026, opening Tuesday through Saturday from 10 a.m. to 10 p.m. daily.

The expo represents a collaborative effort between the university and local business leadership to showcase entrepreneurship and economic development in the Nablus region.

title: Al-Najah University plans first Tedi business expo
